statement: let v := fun (X n : ℕ) => if n ≤ X then ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n else 0; let F := fun (X H : ℕ) => (Finset.range (X+H+1)).sum (fun t => ((Finset.range H).sum (fun j => if j ≤ t then v X (t-j) else 0))^2); ∃ δ b : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ < 1/2 ∧ 0 < b ∧ ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ X : ℕ, B < X ∧ 3*((X:ℝ)*Real.log X-X)+b*(X:ℝ)^(1/2+δ) ≤ F X 3
